{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Soft leggings with an elastic waistband, relaxed fit, mid-calf length, heathered olive green (#6B705C), brushed cotton blend.
A lightweight open-front pullover hoodie, loose drape silhouette, hip-length hem, oat milk beige (#F3EBD3), fine-gauge organic merino wool.
Minimalist canvas sneakers, rounded toe, low-cut profile, pure white (#FFFFFF), durable rubber sole with breathable mesh upper.
This outfit seamlessly transitions her from a grounding morning yoga practice to a cozy coffee catch-up without needing a change. The relaxed fit of the leggings allows for full range of motion during exercise, while the soft, oversized hoodie provides warmth and comfort for the autumn air. The neutral color palette creates a calming visual that reflects both her active state and the relaxing social moment ahead."}
